field_constraints.SchemaVersion: Exact independently approved schema identity; draft not valid for real PASS
field_constraints.SyntheticScope: Real execution must never use DESIGN_VECTOR_ONLY; toy validator refuses real scope
field_constraints.ManifestStatus: Real PASS only after all independent validation obligations; Not Executed never PASS
field_constraints.GateId: Exact approved gate identity and execution nonce/sequence in signed executor receipt
field_constraints.EnvironmentId: Out-of-band qualified executor/environment identity, not self-assertion
field_constraints.RustCargoLLVMVersions: Exact versions plus toolchain binary/SDK/linker hashes in ToolchainIdentityHash
field_constraints.PythonVersion: Exact interpreter/dependency identity, not version string alone
field_constraints.FrozenSourceHEAD: 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters; independently frozen expected HEAD
field_constraints.hash_fields: CompleteSourceRawHash/RegistryHash/CompilerHash/ExpectedHash/OracleHash/ToolchainIdentityHash: 64 lowercase hex, bind independently complete path/length/hash maps
field_constraints.BuildProfile: Exact dev/test debug, opt-level, features, target, rustflags and effective configuration closure
field_constraints.commands: BuildCommand/TestCommand: exact argv arrays plus signed cwd and environment in ExecutorReceipt; no shell interpolation
field_constraints.BuildArtifactHashes: Complete independently required logical path to raw length/hash map, including symbols/dependencies/build outputs/fixtures
field_constraints.ExecutionStartAndEnd: Exact UTC integer nanoseconds and monotonic sequence, ordered and executor-authenticated; toy values are synthetic
field_constraints.ActualExitCode: Integer, never bool/float; zero only for positive PASS gates; frozen expected negative exits require separate explicitly typed denial receipt
field_constraints.ResourcePolicy: Exact approved policy identifier plus hard budgets and per-step class; no caller-defined P_build/J_build
field_constraints.ResourceSafetyStatus: Exact authenticated limits, peaks, samples, cancellations and observation coverage; no cancellation or unknown safety for PASS
field_constraints.RequiredAndCompletedCaseIds: Two complete duplicate-free namespaced lists matching independent approved roster; both-side agreement alone insufficient
field_constraints.ActualOutputHashes: Every required CaseId/output logical path plus raw hash/length and full structured value package for field comparison
field_constraints.IndependentOracleReceipt: Independent frozen Oracle identity, exact case/field roster and compared/missing/unexpected/uncompared counts, original actual/expected/diffs
field_constraints.PreAndPostSourceIntegrity: Both complete raw/GitBlob maps match independent frozen input; no general EOL normalization
field_constraints.CapabilityDenialReceipt: Exact required negative boundaries; no RootExport/Portable positive, CompleteView or ObligationIdentity issued
field_constraints.ExecutorReceipt: Detached signature binds all fields, package hash, requirements hash, key identity, nonce, sequence and effective cwd/env; trusted key out of band
field_constraints.PermittedEquivalenceApproval: Out-of-band exact applicable approvals; no implicit host/path/split/profile/resource substitution

validation_protocol: Bound bytes/path count/depth and reject duplicate keys, unknown keys, invalid UTF-8, links/traversal, nonfinite/float numeric values
Verify independent schema/requirements/complete rosters and authenticated qualification/executor/approval trust roots
Check every side independently for exact types/fields/CaseIds/artifacts/outputs and denied capabilities
Verify canonical signed payload, nonce/replay rules and transport package hashes
Compare complete structured outputs field-by-field; preserve raw hashes and precise differences
Only approved real validator can issue scoped execution evidence; transport never grants production authority
trust_roots: Approved requirements roster and environment/executor keys must be supplied out of band; never trusted from the manifest itself
signature_design: Detached versioned canonical payload signature binds schema, gate requirements, source, toolchain, policy, environment qualification, artifacts and outputs. Actual cryptographic verifier is not implemented or qualified here.
both_sided_omission_rule: Validate each side against fixed approved schema and complete trusted case/artifact rosters before equality comparison
implementation_boundaries: No actual signature, environment qualification, Native receipt, RootExport, Portable capability or PASS certificate is issued
